appointments_expiry_check.name: appointments_expiry_check
appointments_expiry_check.value: "care"."appointments"."status" not in ('held', 'pending') or "care"."appointments"."expires_at" is not null

availability_exceptions_span_check.name: availability_exceptions_span_check
availability_exceptions_span_check.value:
("care"."availability_exceptions"."span" = 'days' and "care"."availability_exceptions"."from_date" is not null and "care"."availability_exceptions"."until_date" is not null and "care"."availability_exceptions"."until_date" >= "care"."availability_exceptions"."from_date")
			or ("care"."availability_exceptions"."span" = 'time' and "care"."availability_exceptions"."from_local" is not null and "care"."availability_exceptions"."until_local" is not null and "care"."availability_exceptions"."until_local" > "care"."availability_exceptions"."from_local")

claim_documents_purge_idx.name: claim_documents_purge_idx
claim_documents_purge_idx.where: "directory"."claim_documents"."purged_at" is null and "directory"."claim_documents"."purge_after" is not null

sites_sitemap_idx.name: sites_sitemap_idx
sites_sitemap_idx.where: "directory"."sites"."slug" is not null and "directory"."sites"."removed_at" is null
